name: visual-ai-agent-extension
description: Chrome extension that observes browsing activity, captures screenshots, and syncs with Visual AI Agent backend.

scripts.package: npm run build && powershell -Command "if (!(Test-Path build)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory build | Out-Null }; Compress-Archive -Path dist/* -DestinationPath build/visual-ai-agent-v1.0.0.zip -Force; Write-Host 'Packaged: build/visual-ai-agent-v1.0.0.zip'"
